**templates** is an Array of requests.

**templateType**
  Supported template types are:
  - `simple_image` - More details are available [here](#simple-image)
  - `simple_text` - More details are available [here](#simple-text)
  - `email` - More details are available [here](#email)
  - `email_subject` - More details are available [here](#email-subject)
  - `instagram_ad` - More details are available [here](#instagram-post)
  - `facebook_post` - More details are available [here](#facebook-post)
  - `blog_post` - More details are available [here](#blog-post)
  - `google_responsive_image_ad` - More details are available [here](#google-responsive-display-ad)
  - `linkedin_image_post` - More details are available [here](#linkedin-social-post)
  - `file_refiner` - More details are available [here](#doc-transform)
  - `meta_ad_v2` - More details are available [here](#meta-ad)
  - `email_sales` - More details are available [here](#sales-email)

  Upcoming template types:
  - `Web blend`
  - `Google search`
  - `Marketing email`
  - `Press release`
  - `Job description`
  - `Text blend`
  - ...

:information_source: Maximum number of Image variations(`simple_image`) one can generate is capped at 4.

This API is asynchronous and returns immediately after accepting the request. You can use the `batchJobStatus` link for monitoring the status of the Generation Job.

An example of bulk generation is available [here](#bulk-generation) to generate multiple contents at once

---
## Simple Image
**Sample Payload for Image gen**
```json
{
  "templates": [
    {
      "templateType": "simple_image",
      "templateParams": {
        "ImageDescription": "Prompt to Generate Image",
        "VariationCount": 2,
        "EnhancePrompt": true,
        "AspectRatio": "banner_w2048_h512"
      }
    }
  ],
  "workflowName": "Generate First Image",
  "requestContext": {} // You can flow any context information that you want to find in the Monitor API response.
}
```
**Sample Response:**
```json
{
  "message": "Request initiated successfully",
  "monitorId": "ed390b26-4d4f-4a27-a3f8-6225e9e84cdd",
  "links": [
    {
      "rel": "batchJobStatus",
      "href": "https://api-us.typeface.ai/batch-service/accounts/8f71f690-5404-4862-a3e4-0ebd6cfe6b88/projects/1/batch-jobs/ed390b26-4d4f-4a27-a3f8-6225e9e84cdd"
    }
  ]
}
```

**Notes:**

`templateParams.ImageDescription` - Prompt for generating image

`templateParams.VariationCount` - Number of variations to generate

`templateParams.Layout` - **(Optional)** An identifier for a layout which can be used in *simple_image* template flow.

**Layout** value can be obtained by making an API call to fetch Layout details, and capturing the `ref` field in response.  The API to fetch available layouts is documented [here](https://developers.typeface.ai/reference/querylayoutmanifestsinproject)

`templateParams.Assets` - **(Optional)** A list of asset identifiers. For `simple_image` template flow, only a single image asset identifier is allowed.

**Assets** value can be obtained by making an API call to fetch Asset details, and capturing the `ref` field in response.  The API to fetch available assets is documented [here](https://developers.typeface.ai/reference/queryassetsinproject)


`templateParams.AudienceSegment` - **(Optional)** An identifier for audience to generate personalized content for specific users.

**AudienceSegment** value can be obtained by making an API call to list Audiences, and capturing the `ref` field in response. The API to fetch available audiences is documented [here](https://developers.typeface.ai/reference/queryaudiencesinaccount)

`templateParams.BrandKitImageStyle` - **(Optional)** An identifier for image style in Brand Kit to generate personalized content for specific brands.

**BrandKitImageStyle** value can be obtained by making an API call to fetch Brand Kit image style details, and capturing the `ref` field in response.  The API to fetch available image styles is documented [here](https://developers.typeface.ai/reference/getstyleinbrandkit)

`templateParams.BrandKitTextStyle` - **(Optional)** An identifier for text style in Brand Kit to generate personalized content for specific brands.

**BrandKitTextStyle** value can be obtained by making an API call to fetch Brand Kit text style details, and capturing the `ref` field in response.  The API to fetch available text styles is documented [here](https://developers.typeface.ai/reference/getstyleinbrandkit)

`templateParams.EnhancePrompt` - true/false. Enhances the user prompt if specified as true.

`templateparams.AspectRatio` - **(Optional)** Determines the aspect ratio for generated images. Allowed values are:
-    `square_w768_h768` (Square 768x768)
-    `square_w1024_h1024` (Square 1024x1024)
-    `landscape_w768_h576` (Landscape 768x576)
-    `landscape_w1024_h768` (Landscape 1024x768)
-    `portrait_w576_h768` (Portrait 576x768)
-    `portrait_w768_h1024` (Portrait 768x1024)
-    `widescreen_w1024_h576` (Widescreen 1024x576)
-    `banner_w2048_h512` (Banner 2048x512)

**Note**:  `AspectRatio` should not be used in conjunction with `Layout` field. To define the  aspect ratio with a Logo, the desired aspect ratio can be added via the typeface.ai Web User Interface.

`workflowName` - This will be deprecated, for now flow any label/random number.

`requestContext` - Any additional information (JSON) client wants to receive as part of polling API response.

## Email
**Sample Payload for Email**
```json
{
  "templates": [
    {
      "templateType": "email",
      "templateParams": {
        "Purpose": "recruit for a new role",
        "Context": "I am recruiting for a senior marketing manager role for my company",
        "FollowUpResponse": "share what time they are available for a meeting"
      }
    }
  ],
  "workflowName": "Generate an Email",
  "requestContext": {} // You can flow any context information that you want to find in the Monitor API response.
}
```
**Notes:**

`templateParams.Purpose` - The main objective or reason for sending the email. This could be to inform, request information, follow up on a previous conversation, schedule a meeting, confirm details, or provide updates.

`templateParams.Context` - The background information and circumstances related to the email. This includes any relevant details that help the recipient understand the reason for the email and its importance.

`templateParams.FollowUpResponse` - The anticipated or requested action that the recipient should take after reading the email. This could be replying with specific information, confirming receipt, providing feedback, scheduling a meeting, or any other response that moves the conversation or process forward.

`templateParams.Assets` - **(Optional)** A list of asset identifiers. For `email` template flow, only file asset identifiers are allowed.

**Assets** value can be obtained by making an API call to fetch Asset details, and capturing the `ref` field in response.  The API to fetch available assets is documented [here](https://developers.typeface.ai/reference/queryassetsinproject)

`templateParams.AudienceSegment` - **(Optional)** An identifier for audience to generate personalized content for specific users.

**AudienceSegment** value can be obtained by making an API call to list Audiences, and capturing the `ref` field in response. The API to fetch available audiences is documented [here](https://developers.typeface.ai/reference/queryaudiencesinaccount)

`templateParams.BrandKitImageStyle` - **(Optional)** An identifier for image style in Brand Kit to generate personalized content for specific brands.

**BrandKitImageStyle** value can be obtained by making an API call to fetch Brand Kit image style details, and capturing the `ref` field in response.  The API to fetch available image styles is documented [here](https://developers.typeface.ai/reference/getstyleinbrandkit)

`templateParams.BrandKitTextStyle` - **(Optional)** An identifier for text style in Brand Kit to generate personalized content for specific brands.

**BrandKitTextStyle** value can be obtained by making an API call to fetch Brand Kit text style details, and capturing the `ref` field in response.  The API to fetch available text styles is documented [here](https://developers.typeface.ai/reference/getstyleinbrandkit)

`templateParams.Content` - The content is the core of the blog post. It provides readers with valuable information, insights, or entertainment. Quality content helps to engage readers, rank higher in search engines, and build credibility in your niche.

`templateParams.ImageDescription` - This field allows the user to provide a detailed description of any images used in the blog post. The description should include the visual content, purpose, and context of the image.

## Google Responsive Display Ad
**Sample Payload for Google Responsive Display Ad**
```json
  {
      "templates": [
          {
              "templateType": "google_responsive_image_ad",
              "templateParams": {
                  "Goal": "leads",
                  "AudienceSegment": "eyJhY.....LCJlbnRpdHl....AifQ=",
                  "BusinessName": "Indian Premier League",
                  "DisplayURL": "www.ipl.co.in",
                  "Summary": "Chennai super kings won the last IPL",
                  "NumberOfHeadlines": 11,
                  "NumberOfLongHeadline": 2,
                  "NumberOfDescriptions": 4,
                  "ImageDescription": "A glass of apple juice on sandy dunes with cocunut and palm trees",
                  "EnhancePrompt": true
              }
          }
      ],
      "workflowName": "Simple Google Responsive Ad",
      "requestContext": {} // You can flow any context information that you want to find in the Monitor API response.  
  }
```
**Notes:**

`templateParams.Goal` - The primary objective of the ad, such as increasing brand awareness, driving website traffic, or generating leads.

`templateParams.AudienceSegment` - An identifier for audience to generate personalized content for specific users.

**AudienceSegment** value can be obtained by making an API call to list Audiences, and capturing the `ref` field in response. The API to fetch available audiences is documented [here](https://developers.typeface.ai/reference/queryaudiencesinaccount)

`templateParams.BusinessName` - The name of your business as it should appear in the ad, ensuring brand recognition.

`templateParams.DisplayURL` - The web address that will appear in the ad, directing users to your landing page.

`templateParams.Summary` - Describe your product or services.

`templateParams.NumberOfHeadlines` - **(Optional)** An identifier for number of headlines to be generated for google responsive display ad. Default value is 11.

`templateParams.NumberOfLongHeadline` - **(Optional)** An identifier for number of long headlines to be generated for google responsive display ad. Default value is 2.

`templateParams.NumberOfDescriptions` - **(Optional)** An identifier for number of descriptions to be generated for google responsive display ad. Default value is 4.

`templateParams.ImageDescription` - This field allows the user to provide a detailed description of any images used in the ad. The description should include the visual content, purpose, and context of the image.

`templateParams.Assets` - **(Optional)** A list of asset identifiers. For `google_responsive_image_ad` template flow, only a single image asset identifier is allowed.

**Assets** value can be obtained by making an API call to fetch Asset details, and capturing the `ref` field in response.  The API to fetch available assets is documented [here](https://developers.typeface.ai/reference/queryassetsinproject)

`templateParams.BrandKitImageStyle` - **(Optional)** An identifier for image style in Brand Kit to generate personalized content for specific brands.

## Meta Ad
**Sample Payload for Meta Ad**
```json
  {
      "templates": [
          {
              "templateType": "meta_ad_v2",
              "templateParams": {
                  "Goal": "sales",
                  "AdType": "carousel_ad",
                  "BusinessName": "Cecilié Apple Juice",
                  "DisplayURL": "www.cecilie.com",
                  "ProductName": "Apple juice for healthy minded people",
                  "AudienceSegment":"eyJhY.....LCJlbnRpdHl....AifQ=",
              }
          }
      ],
      "workflowName": "Meta ad",
      "requestContext": {} // You can flow any context information that you want to find in the Monitor API response.  
  }
```
**Notes:**

`templateParams.Goal` - The primary objective of the ad, such as increasing brand awareness, driving website traffic, generating leads, boosting sales, promoting app downloads, or encouraging engagement.

`templateParams.AdType` - The format of the ad, such as a single image ad, a carousel with multiple images, or a collection showcasing multiple products. 

  Possible values are: 
  * `single_image_ad`

  * `carousel_ad`

  * `collection_ad`



`templateParams.BusinessName` - The name of your business as it should appear in the ad, ensuring brand recognition.
